summary: East kerb backing onto dense creek bush, no homes within 25 m.
reasons: Backs onto dense bush near creek

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush behind the kerb; nearest homes are 14 m at 130 m and 27 m at 124 m, both behind the start of the section.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed kerb with no signs; trees and a short pull-in before the junction leave room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Residential street with a roundabout just ahead; moderate local traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the street, so a van does not stand out.

flags: Low-lying: about 4-5 m elevation, Witton Creek 16 m away, flood-prone
Section ends close to the roundabout
sun_shade: Heavily shaded by tree canopy, mostly from the east and south.
cannot_judge: Exact distance needed clear of the junction

best_section.where: Kate Street east kerb, last stretch before the roundabout, beside the wooded block
